verdict.rationale: The repo documents an explicit `yy skills update` command (alongside `yy skills install`) that picks the latest compatible stable release and updates all three agent copies, so users get fixes without reinstalling. It also documents safe handling of customized or legacy copies, which are flagged for review rather than overwritten, and the skills are independently versioned with a marketplace manifest. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the update command works, documentation of whether marketplace/plugin installs auto-update, and fuller update docs such as version pinning, rollback, and update guidance for `npx skills` installs.
